Puzzle play, updates and connected availability

CASCADE is a single-player puzzle game in which one persistent row is reordered across platforms to an exact receiver target. Shape, word and mixed modes can have separate progression. Mechanics, difficulty and content may be adjusted to fix faults and improve play, but the publisher must not misrepresent what a paid product provides.

Core local play and optional connected features have different availability. Sign-in, synchronization, purchase verification and ads require the relevant provider, configuration and network connection. We may maintain or update those services. No uninterrupted connection, permanent cloud retention, fixed future content schedule or guaranteed score is promised. We will give notice of significant changes where required and respect paid entitlements and mandatory remedies.

This website's small reorder example illustrates the core idea. It is not the full mobile game and does not synchronize its moves or rewards to your account. Promotional artwork is illustrative; native gameplay images show the referenced version, which may change with updates.

Accounts, security and saves

Where offered, Apple or Google sign-in is handled through Unity Player Accounts. Keep your identity and store accounts secure and use information you are authorized to provide. You are responsible for activity you authorize; contact support if you believe your game account has been compromised. Do not share passwords or authentication tokens with the publisher.

Local progress is stored on the device and can be lost if storage is removed or the device is lost. Linking an account is optional where the game permits local play. Cloud backup is available only after the connected feature is enabled and synchronization succeeds. Review any account-choice screen before loading an existing account. Two saves do not automatically create a combined balance or duplicate entitlements.

Support may require a player identifier and transaction reference to investigate a lost purchase. The publisher cannot restore a save that was never backed up or recover an account controlled solely by another provider without that provider's verification. Use the data-request contact in the Privacy Policy to request game-data deletion; uninstalling and deleting an external identity are different actions.

Purchases and virtual items

If purchases are available, the price, currency and product description displayed by Apple App Store or Google Play at confirmation control that purchase. Your store processes payment under its own terms. Do not assume a website illustration or an unconfigured preview is a live offer. The current catalog contains removal of automatic ads and consumable coin packs; it does not create a subscription merely by showing a recurring reminder.

Coins, tools, rewards and cosmetics are for use inside CASCADE. They have no cash value, are not a bank deposit or investment, and cannot be redeemed for money or transferred outside supported game features. Do not sell or exchange accounts, balances or items through unauthorized services. A cosmetic trophy changes appearance; tools can have a described gameplay effect. Read the item's cost, limits and consequence before using it.

A consumable is used up when spent. Removal of automatic ads is a non-consumable entitlement for the relevant store account, subject to verification and store rules. Optional rewarded ads can remain if clearly offered separately. Purchases are processed through the store rather than by sending card information to this website. Verification can leave an order pending until the store and server confirm it; repeatedly tapping does not authorize duplicate grants.

Restoration, refunds and problems

Restore purchases in the game requests eligible entitlements from the current store account. Use the same Apple or Google store account that made the purchase. Non-consumable entitlements may be restored after verification. Already consumed coin packs are not purchased again or recredited by pressing Restore. Successfully synchronized remaining inventory may be recovered separately through the game account.

Refunds and cancellation requests follow the relevant store process and applicable consumer law. Nothing in these Terms removes mandatory refund, conformity, withdrawal or other consumer rights. Digital-content withdrawal rules and any required consent are governed by law and the platform's purchase process; we do not assume that merely playing waives them. If an entitlement is refunded, revoked or found invalid, the game may remove the corresponding entitlement according to store rules and lawful safeguards.

For a missing item, avoid repurchasing until the issue is investigated. Contact shapeinc25@gmail.com with your platform, app version, game identifier if available and store order reference. Never send a password or full card details. The publisher can investigate fulfillment but cannot override Apple or Google's own account or billing controls.

Ads, reminders and choices

If the released version includes ads, automatic ads must appear at appropriate transitions rather than interrupting an active puzzle. An optional rewarded offer describes what can be earned before you choose it. An interrupted or unverified ad may not produce a reward. Advertising providers operate under their own policies and the privacy choices applicable to you.

Local reminders require operating-system permission. You can disable them in the game or device settings without losing the license to play. Optional tracking or measurement consent is separate from these Terms and can be declined or withdrawn through the appropriate controls. We do not treat a notification permission as consent to advertising profiling.

Fair use and prohibited conduct

Do not interfere with service security, impersonate another person, submit fraudulent receipts, exploit a defect to repeatedly obtain paid items, manipulate server grants, use stolen accounts, introduce malicious code, or intentionally damage another user's access. Do not bypass a lawful payment or access control. Automated security research or interoperability permitted by law remains subject to the applicable legal safeguards.

If you discover a serious fault, report it privately to shapeinc25@gmail.com with enough information to reproduce it without exposing another person's data. The publisher may investigate suspected abuse and restrict connected features proportionately where justified. We do not promise to remove legitimate offline progress merely because a network request failed, and an adverse action can be raised with support.

Support, suspension and ending use

You can stop playing, uninstall the app and request applicable game-data deletion. Stopping use does not automatically cancel an external store or identity account or erase a store's lawful billing records. The publisher can suspend connected access for a material violation, security incident, legal obligation or service discontinuation, with notice and an opportunity to resolve the issue where appropriate and feasible.

Restrictions should be proportionate to the issue. Where a service or paid feature is materially discontinued, the publisher must respect applicable consumer rights and any required remedy. Contact shapeinc25@gmail.com to challenge a restriction or ask for help. Do not send sensitive credentials as proof.

Nothing excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable liability for fraud, intentional misconduct, personal injury, gross negligence or mandatory consumer remedies. For other claims, responsibility is limited only to the extent permitted by the law that applies to you.
